therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell exhaustion reversal and anti-tumor immune response activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Treatment naïve participants with locally advanced or recurrent or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer who are deemed unsuitable for platinum-doublet chemotherapy

subgroup_findings: PD-L1 positive subgroup: OS HR 0.84 (95% CI 0.61-1.15), p=0.272
Longer duration of response: 14.0 vs 7.8 months
safety_signals: Serious AEs included acute myocardial infarction (2 patients), acute coronary syndrome (1 patient), acute left ventricular failure (1 patient)
results.dose_information: Atezolizumab administered via IV infusion once every three weeks
